feedback: The confession follows the strongest available chain: Chip's closure work, material denial, false date and admitted glass handling. His acknowledgement that the scrap is not a unique fingerprint respects an uncertainty the evidence explicitly preserved. Opening during the preview and later placing poison in the glass are new admissions of the act, but the finale does not introduce a new witness, test or hidden access rule to make them possible. The case therefore feels earned as a cumulative accusation, though still less than an exclusive deduction before voting. The final loss of professional trust lands well. Elle and Monet accepting their own financial misconduct gives the innocent resolutions consequences rather than making them simple exoneration speeches.
